en.t: Convulsions... repeating the same thing over and over...

units.source_text: 老是梦见不同的东西，投身进去的样子反复不变……

en.t: Always dreaming of different things, yet the way of throwing oneself into them repeats without changing...

units.source_text: 吃饭、走路、睡觉、打嗝儿、叫唤、性交……

en.t: Eating, walking, sleeping, belching, crying out, having sex...
